name: Band Shrug
cardText:
Band Shrug
Novice
1
Place the band under your feet. Stand upright.
2
Elevate your shoulder blades and then depress back to the starting position.

name: Band Horizontal Shrug
cardText:
Band Horizontal Shrug
Novice
1
Anchor the band at shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
2
Retract your shoulder blades straight back in schools. Then protract to the starting position.

name: Band Upright Row
cardText:
Band Upright Row
Advanced
1
Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.
